name: Sasaki Yukinari
source: A kind spirited boy. Since when he was young, he was ridiculed by girls throughout all his life. Because of this, he developed an allergy to women. His allergy triggers whenever he comes into contact with girls, to the point of fainting whenever his reaction becomes too high.
